gloss: right-hand component of a kanji; tsukuri

definitions.gloss: right-hand component of a kanji; the right-side radical element
definitions.explanation: The right-hand element of a kanji that has a left-right structure. It contrasts with {偏|へん}, the left-side element. For example, in {時|じ} (time), {日|ひ} is the {偏|へん} and {寺|じ} is the {旁|つくり}. The {旁|つくり} often carries a phonetic hint, while the {偏|へん} carries semantic meaning.

examples.english: The right-hand component of a kanji.
The right-hand component of "時" is "寺".

examples.japanese: {旁|つくり}は{読|よ}み{方|かた}のヒントになることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The right-hand component often gives a hint about the reading.

examples.japanese: {漢字|かんじ}は{偏|へん}と{旁|つくり}の{組|く}み{合|あ}わせでできているものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many kanji are made up of a combination of a left-side radical and a right-side component.

notes:
Literally "the made thing" or "construction," from the verb {作|つく}る. In kanji analysis, {旁|つくり} refers specifically to the right-hand portion of a character that can be split into left and right elements.

Note that つくり has several unrelated meanings (construction, make, facial features, sashimi-style fish — お{造|つく}り). The kanji-radical sense is written {旁|つくり} when written in kanji, but is very often written in hiragana.

USAGE:
Used in discussions of kanji etymology, dictionary lookup, and character description. Native speakers sometimes describe unfamiliar kanji as "{偏|へん}は〜、{旁|つくり}は〜" (the left side is 〜, the right side is 〜).

KEY PAIRINGS:
- {偏|へん} + {旁|つくり}: the classic left-right structure (e.g., {時|じ}、{話|わ}、{校|こう})
- In such kanji, {偏|へん} usually carries meaning, while {旁|つくり} often carries a phonetic hint

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢字|かんじ}の{旁|つくり}: the right-hand component of a kanji
- {旁|つくり}が{同|おな}じ: having the same right-hand component
- {偏|へん}と{旁|つくり}: left-side and right-side components

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偏|へん}: the left-hand component — the natural counterpart of {旁|つくり}
- にんべん / きへん: specific named left-side radicals
- {部首|ぶしゅ}: radical (the general term for kanji components used in dictionary lookup)
- {冠|かんむり}: crown radical (top part of a kanji, e.g., ⺌ in {小|しょう})
- {脚|あし}: leg radical (bottom part of a kanji)
